description: What waits for human review. Each week 10 ai_verified playlists are picked at random, with every golden-set checklist that holds a reference playlist; a playlist the independent verifier's rebuilds left disputed is put here too, and so is a school policy they left disputed: an AI's rebuild never replaces a school's policy on its own. For each one waiting the answer gives playlist_id and checklist_id, or for a school policy its policy_id, with school, built_by, verified_by and picked_at, when it was picked. Review each through playlist_review with reviewer_type human; it then leaves the queue. Read-only.
name: playlist_review_queue
title: Playlist Review Queue
